block-guide: CORE/POST-FEATURED-IMAGE (Featured Image) Draws the featured image of the current page or post. The image is the record's featuredImage (save-content, an attachment id from the media library), never set in the block. Places: a Fabrement template frame (above or beside the title) or a Query's post-template (cards). A Fabrement template replaces the whole page, so the theme's featured image is not drawn unless the frame has this block. MARKUP (comment only; no HTML) aspectRatio: "1", "4/3", "3/2", "16/9", "3/4"…; the image is cropped to it (scale "cover", the default; "contain" shows it whole). Without aspectRatio the image keeps its own shape. align: "wide" or "full" (also left / right / center). isLink links to the record. sizeSlug picks a registered image size ("large", "full"); the default is the theme's post-thumbnail size. OUTPUT The alt text is the attachment's own alt text: set it on the media item. PITFALLS - A record without a featured image draws NOTHING (no figure, no gap). Set featuredImage on the records, or the template shows no image. - A small upload is not enlarged in quality: width 100% stretches it. Use an image at least as wide as the place it fills. - Outside a Query on an archive it shows the first listed post's image. CHECK Open an assigned page that has a featured image, and one that has none.
